[1] The second single released from the tape was "All Day" which Burna recorded with some vocal assistance from fellow Garden City singer Bukwild Da Ikwerrian.
[2] Singer Shontelle and production duo Rock City wrote the song with its main producer, Sham.
[3] The duo has since co-written and produced tracks such as "Man Down" by Rihanna and "Who Gon Stop Me" by Kanye West and Jay-Z, both of which charted prominently on "Billboard".
[4] In 2008, Sinclair collaborated with French recording artist M. Pokora in the song "They Talk Shit About Me", as Verse.
